findings.title: Jump-to-latest floats over content with a weak edge
findings.note: White disc on white content, overlapping the last block (math on desktop, tool card on wide, code header on mobile). It sits bottom-centre of the transcript, so it always covers whatever content reaches the fold. Fix: solid background, stronger border/shadow, larger inset. Evidence: ui-review/filled/desktop/chat-rich-sec0.png, ui-review/filled/mobile/chat-rich-sec0.png, ui-review/filled/wide/chat-rich-sec0.png
findings.regression_test: apps/web/test/transcript.test.tsx — jump-to-latest carries a solid surface, a strong edge and a layer shadow

findings.title: Error card promises a retry action that does not exist
findings.note: The card says the error can be retried while retry is deferred to M3. Fix: add a retry button that resends the last prompt, or drop the promise. Evidence: ui-review/filled/desktop/chat-error-sec0.png
findings.regression_test: apps/web/test/transcript.test.tsx — offers Continue and Retry under a stopped assistant message

findings.title: No product branding on the login screen
findings.note: The app header shows OpenChat, the login card only Sign in. Fix: add the wordmark above the card. Evidence: ui-review/empty/desktop/login.png
findings.regression_test: apps/web/test/login.test.tsx — the wordmark renders above the sign-in card

findings.title: Two different empty-state treatments
findings.note: Landing centers a hero, an empty chat shows one muted line pinned under the header. Fix: center the chat empty state or reuse the hero. Evidence: ui-review/empty/desktop/chat-empty-sec0.png
findings.regression_test: apps/web/test/transcript.test.tsx — an empty transcript renders the shared hero, centred

findings.title: Keyboard hint shown on touch viewports
findings.note: Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line is shown on phones. Fix: hide under (pointer: coarse) or swap the copy. Evidence: ui-review/empty/mobile/landing.png
findings.regression_test: apps/web/test/composer.test.tsx — the hint is hidden behind a coarse pointer

findings.title: Mermaid diagram labels are unreadable on mobile
findings.note: Labels render at about 7 px when the diagram is scaled to the 390 px column. Fix: minimum diagram width with horizontal scroll, or tap-to-zoom. Evidence: ui-review/filled/mobile/chat-rich-sec1.png
findings.regression_test: apps/web/test/mermaid.test.tsx — the canvas keeps a readable minimum width inside the scroller

findings.title: Password focus ring reads as an error state
findings.note: Outline plus border produce a heavy double ring on focus. Fix: use one focus ring. Evidence: ui-review/empty/mobile/login.png
findings.regression_test: apps/web/test/login.test.tsx — both fields use the single-ring focus utility

findings.title: Dictation microphone has no button surface next to the filled send disc
findings.note: The idle mic is a bare glyph in a transparent circle while the send control beside it is a filled disc, so the mic reads as decoration rather than a control at 390 and 1440 px. The recording pill itself is clean (clock, meter, stop, cancel). Fix: give the idle mic the same soft surface as the send button, or make both ghost. Evidence: ui-review/empty/desktop/landing.png, ui-review/empty/mobile/landing.png
